What Is reVeal? • reVeal1 (the reV2 Extension for Analyzing Loads) is an open-source, flexible geospatial platform designed to inform the disaggregation of national or regional load Data Source: EER 2024 U.S. ADP Scenario Annual Decarbonization Perspective projections into highly resolved estimates of large load additions by characterizing site suitability across the country. • reVeal bridges the gap between national (or regional) load projections and informed, highly resolved load estimates required in power systems modeling • reVeal helps answer the question of where can a capacity-strained grid quickly and flexibly add tens to hundreds of gigawatts of new load from data centers?
